米娅与月光小院的计划(Mia and the the moon-lit yard: 一篇关于节日文化的A2短文:米娅与本的经历和小计划。
The temple fair is one of the best places in the city. Mia thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like rice and water. Rice covers the high chair tray.
There are always many people at the moon-lit yard. Mia learned a lot about English. They took many photos at the moon-lit yard. She grew up in an orphanage in Seoul.
Mia and Ben had great fun there. Ben's birthday is in February. Mia wants to be a nurse in the future. The soup is made with beef and tomatoes.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the temple fair by bike. Mia likes sunny days best. Ben is interested in swimming.
